name: trackiq-amazon-launch-scorecard
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Launch Scorecard
summary: Grades a newly launched Amazon ASIN week by week through its first twelve weeks — units and revenue against a target curve, session growth, conversion rate, review accumulation, organic rank on its target keywords, and TACoS against a declining break-even glide path — ending in a go, hold or fix verdict with one lever.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
